messages.message: Hello! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I'm Ravi. How can I help you today? 😊
Hi Ravi, mera plan change karna hai. Current plan bahut expensive hai and data limit khatam ho jati hai jaldi.
I can certainly help you with that. Before we proceed, could you please provide your account number for verification?
Haan, account number hai 31667923. My name is Vivek Johnson.
Thank you, Mr. Johnson. I understand it's frustrating when your data runs out too quickly. Let me check the best options for you.
Please jaldi karo, I need a cheaper plan with more data. Address is 272 Linking Road.
I have a great plan for you. The new monthly price will be 599 rupees and the change takes effect from the 1st of next month.
The price is okay, but network issues are also there. Signal bahut weak hai mere area mein.
I can assure you there won't be any more outages in your area.
I hope so. Abhi payment pending hai, let me give you my card details: four eight zero eight four one four eight five two five three eight eight eight two.
Got it. I will now process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your number 96139 16392.
Wait, why is the SMS not coming? It's been 2 minutes. Yeh kya mazaak hai? I'm getting angry now!
Please bear with me, the system is a bit slow. Is there anything else I can help you with? I'll ensure the plan is updated and the SMS is sent. Goodbye!
Nahi, nothing else! Your service is pathetic. I am very dissatisfied with this experience. 😡
